decision_reason: RETAIN original non-alignment oracle: GNU aligned(16) typedef new_int is never instantiated or queried. The sole abort checks sizeof(struct S)==sizeof(int), an unrelated one-int struct size fact. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS but optimized and O0 assembly return zero without examining aligned typedef. KCC rejects attribute syntax. Do not register a spurious alignment success; later add a meaningful alignment assertion.

RETAIN hosted formatting: 15 fixed signed long-long operand pairs exercise add/sub/mul/div with exact table values and abort after failures; failing path calls real printf with five varargs. GCC/KCC PDP6 O0/noopt cannot link actual printf. A fake printf or removed diagnostic changes original hosted ABI dependency, so preserve source for real runtime integration.

RETAIN target-width and arithmetic investigation: 1000 iterations of generated random unsigned/signed int/short/char division and remainder, with original abort invariants; random_bitstring uses 8*sizeof(long) for bit termination rather than PDP10 CHAR_BIT=9, and signed short/char divisions may meet zero divisors without a guard. Both GCC/KCC PDP6 baseline RUN_FAIL. Need independently derive native target range and zero divisor policy before promoting or changing values.

ACTIVATE GCC native PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os all PASS: unsigned long long variable_shift and constant_shift execute two complete 71-entry loops with exact target table for BITS=71 and abort on each mismatch, not a vacuous fallback. Source already selects __LONG_LONG_71BIT__ table; KCC noopt rejects unsupported wide-int source; keep byte-identical PDP10 counterpart deferred for KCC feature gate, no duplicate execution.

ACTIVATE GCC native PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os all PASS: signed long long variable/constant arithmetic right shifts are compared to both positive zext and negative sext target-specific 71-entry tables in four loops (284 assertions/iteration checks), including sign extension. KCC noopt rejects 71-bit tables/syntax; identical PDP10 counterpart remains deferred, canonical active GCC owner is the wide-int source.

ACTIVATE GCC native PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os all PASS: function-pointer tables call bad0..bad10 whose __builtin_constant_p must be false, good0..good2 whose result must be true, and under __OPTIMIZE__ execute opt0..opt2 that must be true. O0 excludes optimized-only assertions; O1/O2/Os exercise them. KCC noopt reports internal dodecl: scope mismatch compiler errors plus 45 diagnostics; preserve for compiler ICE triage, KCC unsupported GNU builtin dialect. Identical PDP10 copy stays deferred; no duplicate matrix registration.

ACTIVATE narrowly scoped GCC native PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os all PASS: sizeof aggregate with long bitfields f8:8,f24:24 must equal sizeof aggregate with f32:32; both fit a 36-bit word (4 native 9-bit char units) under current ABI, and compiler-folded size equality selects exit(0). This does not check field readback or binary layout/endianness. KCC rejects nonstandard long-bitfield declaration; identical PDP10 copy remains deferred for KCC.

ACTIVATE as failing GCC GNU packed bitfield regression: original bar.half=0x1234 and 32-bit unsigned long whole=0x56789abcL, both explicitly read back by f and abort if mismatched. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os all RUN_FAIL; emitted O0 assembly contains both actual readback comparisons. KCC rejects packed unsigned-long bitfield syntax; same-assertion PDP10 copy stays deferred for KCC. Never claim a passing profile or alter original width constants.

RETAIN incompatible original 32-bit promotion oracle: unsigned long u32:32 and unsigned long long ull35:35 are expected to remain unsigned after promotion, but PDP10 native int has 36 bits, making these field widths potentially fit signed int. Several tests use sizeof(int)>=4 for a 32-bit assumption. Both GCC and KCC PDP6 baseline fail (GCC runtime, KCC compile); derive C promotion rules and target expected signs for 36-bit int before any source adaptation.

RETAIN wide signed bitfield target expectations: two 52-bit signed long-long fields with 12-bit pad, record copies and OR into field, compare to fixed 64-bit-style sign-extension mask 0xFFFFFF541FFF567FLL. GCC PDP6 O0 RUN_FAIL and KCC noopt rejects long long bitfields; 71-bit signed long-long target makes mask/field semantics uncertain. Preserve original and derive native expectation before compiler diagnosis.
